g.text: Update: ex_pc, actual_target, taken from EX
Burst Refill FSM (10 Cycles on Miss):
EX Controls: ALUSrcA, ALUSrcB, ALUOp[3:0], Branch, Jump
Math Select: is_mul, is_div, is_fpu, is_zbb (M/F/Zbb enable)
Dual Asynchronous Read Ports | Synchronous Write Port (x0=0)
Write Addr: rd_wb [4:0] | Write Data: wb_data [31:0]
Sign-Extends I, S, B, U, J Format Immediates
FORWARDING UNIT (Dual RAW Data Bypass Detection)
Inputs: id_ex_rs1[4:0], id_ex_rs2[4:0], ex_mem_rd[4:0], ex_mem_regwrite, mem_wb_rd[4:0], mem_wb_regwrite
Distance-1 RAW Hazard (EX/MEM): forward=01 | Distance-2 RAW Hazard (MEM/WB): forward=10
Outputs: forward_a [1:0], forward_b [1:0] (Controls Forward Muxes A & B)
ADD, SUB, AND, OR, XOR, SLL, SRL, SRA, SLT
DSP48E1 Slice & Radix-4 Booth (Runtime sw[3] toggle)
out: fpu_out [31:0] | fpu_busy [1b] to Hazard Unit
CLZ, CTZ, CPOP, MIN/MAX, ANDN, ORN, ROL/ROR
Comparator: BEQ, BNE, BLT, BGE, BLTU, BGEU

svg.text: branch_taken & actual_target [31:0] (Pipeline Redirect to IF & BTB Update)

g.text: Burst Refill FSM (10 Cycles on Miss):
Formats: LB, LBU, LH, LHU, LW (Alignment & Sign-Ext)

svg.text: 1. RETIREMENT WRITEBACK BUS: wb_data [31:0], rd_wb [4:0], reg_write_wb [1b] (Writes to RegFile)
2. DISTANCE-1 FORWARDING BUS: ex_mem_result [31:0] (Bypasses to EX Forward Muxes)
3. DISTANCE-2 FORWARDING BUS: wb_data [31:0] (Bypasses to EX Forward Muxes)
